commands.step: Use an OIDC-capable npm (Trusted Publishing needs npm >= 11.5)
Assert package.json version matches release tag
commands.text:
PKG_VERSION=$(node -p "require('./package.json').version")
TAG="${RELEASE_TAG#v}"
if [ "$PKG_VERSION" != "$TAG" ]; then
  echo "package.json version ($PKG_VERSION) does not match release tag ($RELEASE_TAG)"
  exit 1
fi

commands.step: Publish to npm via Trusted Publishing (OIDC)
